title: bug: a seat's Serena server is unusable for 15-23 min at startup when a big tree is excluded only via .git/info/exclude (UnAI .moe-next/trees); the launchers should hand Serena git's own ignore set
description:
Reported by the human on 2026-11-03 from the UnAI fleet: "MCP task k12f44qvb (serena/read_memory) failed." The owner wants the fix in Moe's source, not as a hand-made workaround inside the UnAI repo.

OBSERVED (D:/projexts/UnAI, shared mode, 2026-11-03)
- architect-e0242da9 made 5 Serena calls in parallel at 06:55:40Z: 4 read_memory and 1 list_memories. Each failed with "Error executing tool read_memory: TimeoutError:" at Serena's tool_timeout of 240 s, one after another; k12f44qvb failed at 07:03:43Z. The seat transcript is acct-1 .../-mnt-d-projexts-UnAI/15b604e6-*.jsonl.
- Every Serena server started at the UnAI root today processed 115 .gitignore files, 112 of them under .moe-next/trees. The three that finished took 15m54s, 17m37s and 23m13s (~/.serena/logs/2026-11-03/mcp_20261103-083718_*, -084426_*, -085526_*). Eleven more never finished, and the logs hold 41 TimeoutError lines. The UnAI governor counted 66 of 434 Serena servers with timeouts on 11-02.

CAUSE (verified in serena-agent 1.6.2.dev0, ~/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/.../site-packages)
- serena/project.py _gather_ignorespec: when ignore_all_files_in_gitignore is true (the default), it runs GitignoreParser(project_root). Tools wait for that ignore spec.
- serena/util/file_system.py GitignoreParser._iter_gitignore_files: walks the whole tree breadth-first. It prunes a directory only when an already-loaded .gitignore pattern matches it, and it also enters .git/.
- It never reads .git/info/exclude or core.excludesFile. Global and project ignored_paths are merged only after the walk, so they cannot prune it.
- UnAI hides .moe-next/ and .serena/ only in .git/info/exclude. .moe-next/trees holds 112 git worktrees made by the separate moe-next tool, on the slow /mnt/d drvfs mount.
- Moe's launchers give every seat its own Serena via the MCP config they write (moe-agent.sh ~:1063-1641, moe-agent.ps1 ~:774-1614: start-mcp-server --project <root>). So every new seat pays the walk, and the seat's early Serena calls die at 240 s.

FACTS FOR THE FIX
- git computes the same ignore set fast: `git -C /mnt/d/projexts/UnAI ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard --directory` returns 48 entries in 0.8 s. It honours .gitignore, info/exclude and core.excludesFile, and prunes ignored directories.
- Serena applies .serena/project.local.yml as a shallow key override over project.yml (serena/config/serena_config.py ~:713, yaml_data.update). `ignore_all_files_in_gitignore: false` skips the walk entirely, and `ignored_paths` then becomes the whole ignore set. UnAI already has a project.local.yml (Serena's commented template).

SUGGESTED FIX (the architect confirms or replaces it)
- In both launchers, before a seat's Serena entry is written, compute git's ignored set for the Serena project root.
- Hand it to Serena together with .git/, with the walk off. The likely vehicle is .serena/project.local.yml:
  - merge it with any keys the user already set;
  - union in project.yml's own ignored_paths, because a local key replaces the project's;
  - write it only when the content changes.
- Fail open: when Serena is absent, git fails, or the root is not a git repo, change nothing (today's behaviour).
- Consider worktree mode too. The launch already rewrites W/.serena/project.yml (WT-06). A project that excludes .worktrees/ only via info/exclude would have its control-checkout Serena walk every task worktree in the same way.
- Alternatives to weigh: an upstream Serena fix (honour info/exclude, skip .git), or pinning a fixed Serena.
definitionOfDone: With a fixture git repo in which a directory holding many nested .gitignore files is excluded only via .git/info/exclude, a seat launch through scripts/moe-agent.sh and through scripts/moe-agent.ps1 leaves Serena configured so that its ignore spec is built without walking that directory. A test asserts the exact override: the walk is off, and the excluded directory and .git/ are in the ignored set. The test also shows that keys the user already set in .serena/project.local.yml, and project.yml's own ignored_paths, are preserved.
Fail-open: when Serena is not installed, git fails, or the project root is not a git repository, the launch proceeds exactly as today and writes no override. Both launchers have a test for this.

Both launchers implement the same behaviour: parity-check.sh exits 0 and the postflight harnesses pass, and worktree-mode launches keep WT-06's W/.serena/project.yml rewrite and the deny lists working.
docs/MEMORY.md (Serena section) and scripts/CLAUDE.md (MCP servers for spawned agents) describe the override, why it exists (Serena's startup walk ignores .git/info/exclude) and how to opt out.

implementationPlan.description:
Prerequisite and contract. This row is the consumer half; it dependsOn task-c6a24053, which lands scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs and its unit suite scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs (read that row's description and its handoff memory `mem:task-task-c6a2405324174deda18c4f672747994f-handoff` first).

The script's contract:
- `node moe-serena-ignore.mjs <serena-root>` always exits 0 and prints exactly one line: `[OK] MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_OVERRIDE: ...`, `[info] MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_OVERRIDE: ... is up to date ...` or `[info] MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_SKIPPED: <reason>; ...`.
- It turns Serena's startup .gitignore walk off in a Moe-managed block of <root>/.serena/project.local.yml, and lists Serena-converted patterns from project.yml, core.excludesFile, info/exclude and every .gitignore that git lists.
- It writes only when git ignores that file, and fails open everywhere else.

Do not edit the script or its suite here. If the contract does not hold, comment on task-c6a24053 and report_blocked.

Then, in scripts/moe-agent.sh, add `serena_ignore_override() { # $1 = Serena's project root`.
- It runs `"$NODE_CMD" "$SCRIPT_DIR/moe-serena-ignore.mjs" "$1"` and prints the one line it returns: [OK] in green; [info] and anything else plain.
- Error handling: a missing script prints one `[WARN] MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_SKIPPED: moe-serena-ignore.mjs is missing next to this wrapper; Serena keeps its own .gitignore walk` line. A non-zero exit or no output prints a WARN with the same code. The launch always continues, and the helper is safe under `set -e` (no bare failing command).
- Under hot reload, SCRIPT_DIR is still the checkout's scripts/, as for ACCOUNT_HELPER.

Call it at two sites:
- (a) In the MCP config function, inside the `if [ -n "$SERENA_CMD" ]` that prints '[OK] Serena MCP project:' (:1041), with "$SERENA_PROJECT".
- (b) In prepare_worktree_launch, right after `case "$mode" in W) serena="$CLI_ROOT" ...` (:3530), only when mode is W and SERENA_CMD is set, with "$CLI_ROOT". It must come after the tooling program, so W/.serena/project.yml already has WT-06's rewrite. KEEP was already handled at site (a).

implementationPlan.description:
The scripts/moe-agent.ps1 twin. Add `function Invoke-MoeSerenaIgnoreOverride([string]$Root)`.
- The script path is (Join-Path $script:MoeScriptRoot 'moe-serena-ignore.mjs').
- Run `& node $script ($Root -replace '\\$', '\.')`. That is the existing PS 5.1 trailing-backslash idiom, and `node` is the pinned alias under the marker.
- Use a local `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'` and try/catch.
- Take the last output line: [OK] in Green; [info] in Gray or default; anything else, and an exception, as one Yellow `[WARN] MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_SKIPPED: ...`.
- A missing script gives the same WARN text as sh, byte for byte; parity-check compares the codes.
- Error handling: nothing in it may throw out of the function or change $LASTEXITCODE handling for later code. Reset $global:LASTEXITCODE if needed, as other helpers do.

Call it at two sites:
- (a) Inside `if ($serenaPath -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $serenaPath)) { ... }`, after its '[OK] Serena MCP enabled' Write-Host (:781), with $serenaProject.
- (b) In Initialize-MoeWorktreeLaunch, right after `$serenaProject = switch -CaseSensitive ($out[-1]) ...` (:3385), only when `$out[-1] -ceq 'W'` and $serenaPath is set, with $script:cliRoot.

Run it as ONE detached job, e.g. `setsid nohup bash -c '<command>; echo $? > <scratch>/exit' > <scratch>/out 2>&1 &`, record its PID, and poll the exit file. - Run it from a normal WSL shell, not env -i, so Windows interop has git and powershell.exe.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. The task's suggestion: a literal `git ls-files --ignored --directory` list with the walk off. Replaced in task-c6a24053 by Serena-converted PATTERNS from the same sources (git lists the .gitignore files, so there is no walk). A literal list goes stale for every directory created mid-session (node_modules after npm ci, build output), which Serena would then index; patterns stay live.
2. An upstream Serena fix, or pinning a fixed Serena. Not under Moe's control, and the human asked for the fix in Moe's source.
3. Serena CLI flags or SERENA_HOME. start-mcp-server has no ignore flag, and global ignored_paths are merged after the walk, so they do not prune it.
4. Embedding the program in both wrappers. Rejected for a standalone sibling script, as moe-account-lease.mjs is: there is one copy to test and no twin-identity risk, and it can land first and inert.
5. The split: the producer task-c6a24053 lands first, and this row keeps the human DoD and lands last (the V12 precedent).
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- A shared-mode launch resolves Serena's root once (sh :1000-1042, ps1 :735-781).
- A worktree launch then remaps it to W in prepare_worktree_launch / Initialize-MoeWorktreeLaunch, after the tooling program copies project.yml with project_name@task. KEEP reuses the shared root, which call (a) already handled.
- The tooling program never copies project.local.yml into W, so W's block starts from an empty user part, as today.
- postflight-worktree fixtures ignore only .worktrees/, .mcp.json and logs/, so the script skips for every existing case.
- The landing's DENY list already keeps W/.serena/* out of every commit.

- XDG_CONFIG_HOME leaking a real ~/.config/git/ignore into the literal expected text: pin it in the knobs.
- Windows Node cannot see the harness's git.ps1 stub, so 'git fails' is shown with a broken repository, not WT_GIT_FAIL.
- The verification takes about 70 min. Run it detached and poll; do not hit the 10-min tool limit.
- task-3acf7f79 (WORKING) also edits both wrappers. In worktree mode that merges by hunk, and only a true conflict comes back.
- The producer is gated on Serena's 1.6.x config semantics (shallow local override). A Serena upgrade that changes them makes the script's block inert or a duplicate-key risk; the producer's opt-out keys avoid duplicates.
